operator_comparisons.name: continue_rejection
operator_comparisons.requirement: Rejected records must never be accepted; later valid records must still run.
operator_comparisons.weak_check:
assert (-2, 'rejected') in run([-2,3])
assert (3, 'accepted') in run([-2,3])

operator_comparisons.name: continue_tail_equivalent
operator_comparisons.requirement: Retain all records; removing a tail continue has no effect.

operator_comparisons.name: factory_isolation
operator_comparisons.requirement: Each bag owns its entries; changes must not leak to another instance.

operator_comparisons.name: factory_read_only_control
operator_comparisons.requirement: Read-only bags need empty entries; identity/independent mutation is not an API promise.

operator_comparisons.name: sort_priority
operator_comparisons.requirement: Sort by first column, then second column for equal first values.
operator_comparisons.source:
def run(rows):
    return sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (r[0], r[1]))

operator_comparisons.name: sort_correlated_control
operator_comparisons.requirement: Allowed rows have equal column values; either key order is equivalent on this domain.
operator_comparisons.source:
def run(rows):
    return sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (r[0], r[1]))

operator_comparisons.name: lambda_capture
operator_comparisons.requirement: Callbacks retain the distinct value at construction, even after loop completion.

operator_comparisons.name: lambda_explicit_argument
operator_comparisons.requirement: Callbacks accept explicit overrides; dropping the parameter breaks this call interface.

operator_comparisons.name: comparison_delegation
operator_comparisons.requirement: Unsupported comparisons delegate to the compatible right operand.

operator_comparisons.name: comparison_no_peer_control
operator_comparisons.requirement: Unrelated objects compare unequal; no peer supports this type.

operator_comparisons.name: cause_diagnostic
operator_comparisons.requirement: The public diagnostic API preserves the original parse failure as an explicit cause.

operator_comparisons.name: cause_private_control
operator_comparisons.requirement: Only public error type and message are contractual; exception chaining is private.

operator_comparisons.name: encoding_roundtrip
operator_comparisons.requirement: Arbitrary byte payloads round-trip without data loss, including undecodable bytes.
operator_comparisons.source:
def run(data):
    return data.decode('utf-8', errors='surrogateescape').encode('utf-8', errors='surrogateescape')

operator_comparisons.name: encoding_ascii_control
operator_comparisons.requirement: Inputs are restricted to ASCII; the error policy has no observable effect.
operator_comparisons.source:
def run(data):
    return data.decode('utf-8', errors='surrogateescape').encode('utf-8', errors='surrogateescape')
